Chief of Vibes turns Claude Code and a git repository into a persistent AI colleague, and into the harness you build your next thing on.

The agent has a name, a goal, and a memory. The memory is plain Markdown in your own repository, so you can open it, read it, and take it anywhere. You do not need to know git: the agent does the git and explains each piece the first time you meet it.

**Start.** Paste one line into Claude Code: *"Set up my agent from https://github.com/ElJoakoDELxD/Chief-of-Vibes"*. The session makes your own private copy and creates the agent there.

## What is in this release

**Your agent is the repository, not the machine.** Every surface Claude Code runs on reaches the same agent. Start on your phone, continue in a terminal, and the agent that answers is the one that answered before. The specification now says so, and names the only two things a surface is allowed to change.

**The specification is a core and its leaves.** `SYSTEM.md` holds what an agent must know before it acts. Everything else is one file per topic, opened when the work reaches it. A generated map ties them together, and a check fails when a pointer stops being true.

**Your copy is not a passenger.** It runs the same checks this repository runs, so an agent cannot quietly damage its own rules. What your copy learns can travel back here, and every other copy inherits it.

**A cleared chat picks the thread back up.** Clear the window and the next turn opens on the note the agent wrote before you cleared it.

## What it does not claim

Nothing here counts as success until somebody outside responds. The system is built so it cannot grade its own homework, and this release changes none of that.

The full contract is `SYSTEM.md`. You do not need to read it to start.
